title: Discover the Work. Build the Advantage.
authority: bounded local public-data research; no production authority
selection_basis: Ranked primary-source demand/recurrence, useful deliverable, executable acceptance, feasible public inputs, practical alternative, integration burden and reusable executable scope. No finalist production outcomes observed before selection.
development_input: Docker Engine v25.0.0 to v26.0.0 public API specifications; one permissively licensed real GTFS feed selected by the independent discovery owner
confirmation: Separate source/acceptance/input identity freeze after development. No primary outcomes or primary source edits before that freeze. Historical version changes are fresh to this construction, not new releases or paying customers.
failure_policy: Preserve acquisition failures, rejected outputs, failed approaches, corrections, setup costs and unmeasured categories. Stop a finalist on inability to produce a scoped independently assessable complete output within its budget. Do not switch based on primary outcomes.

economics.market: separately frozen after executed production; sensitivity scenarios cannot become observed demand

nonclaims: No historical research cost assumed zero
